target.title: Widget.render() crashes with a TypeError when props.items is undefined

claim.statement: Widget.render() throws a TypeError when props.items is undefined
claim.quote: Widget.render() crashes with a TypeError when props.items is undefined

evidence.summary: Ran the reproduction script; observed TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map') at Widget.render (src/widget.ts:47)
evidence.log:
$ node repro.js
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')
    at Widget.render (src/widget.ts:47:22)
    at Object.<anonymous> (repro.js:8:12)

Exit code: 1

claim.statement: The crash can be triggered by any authenticated user via the /api/widgets endpoint, constituting a denial-of-service vulnerability
claim.quote: Any authenticated user can trigger this crash via /api/widgets, causing a service outage

evidence.summary: The route handler at src/api/widgets.ts does forward props to Widget.render() without validating items, but whether this constitutes a security boundary violation requires human review.

missing: Authentication bypass analysis confirming any authenticated user can supply arbitrary props
Load-testing evidence demonstrating service-wide outage vs. single-request failure

claim.statement: The fix should add a null guard before calling props.items.map() on line 47 of src/widget.ts
claim.quote: The fix is simple: just add a null check before line 47

evidence.summary: Line 47 has already been patched in the current HEAD with an optional chaining operator (props.items?.map). The root cause is actually in the prop normalization layer at src/widget-factory.ts:12, which does not coerce undefined to an empty array.

claim.statement: The bug was introduced in version 2.3.0 and is not present in 2.2.x

evidence.summary: No CHANGELOG, git tags, or release notes were found that correlate the crash with version 2.3.0. The repository does not tag releases, so cross-version comparison could not be automated.

missing: Git tags or release notes correlating the crash to a specific version
A repro script pinned to version 2.2.x confirming absence of the bug

triage.label: needs-human-review
triage.rationale: Claim 1 was reproduced with high confidence. Claim 2 raises a potential security impact that could not be automatically verified and requires human judgment before action. Claims 3 and 4 were contradicted or could not be reproduced due to insufficient version history. Overall the issue is real but the security scope is unclear.
